integrity: The proof reduces pairs of unit vectors to twelve relative edge classes, establishes sharp signed-facet chord inequalities, uses a decreasing involutive lower envelope for opposite edges, and gives exact witnesses on every parameter interval. An exact symbolic reconstruction also checked all facet inequalities and sharp witness families. No formal proof assistant or expert attestation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact profile is proved for the stated real regular dodecagonal norm only; no uniform all-polygon formula or complete classification of minimizing pairs is claimed.
title: Complete angle-modulus-of-smoothness profile of the regular dodecagonal plane
